# The same source on another HTML page

This is a different rendered website page, so the footnote scope starts again here.

José Afonso da Silva is cited again and receives a new local footnote for this page.^[See [@silva2026]{.bibentry}]

A second occurrence on the same page reuses that new page-local footnote instead of duplicating the full bibliographic entry.^[See [@silva2026]{.bibentry}]

A historical source can use exactly the same mechanism.^[See [@bloch1953]{.bibentry}]

The historical source is repeated locally and therefore reuses its existing footnote on this page.^[See [@bloch1953]{.bibentry}]

Continue to the [Constitution](constitution.qmd) page for another independent page scope.
